body_es: dbt (Data Build Tool) trata SQL de transformación como código: versionado, testeable, documentado. Models son archivos SQL compilados a tablas/vistas. Refs definen dependencias automáticamente. Tests validez de datos (unique, not_null, custom). Snapshots capturan cambios históricos. Materializaciones son: table (física), view (lógica), incremental (inserta solo nuevos), ephemeral (temporal). dbt compila a DAG ejecutado en BD destino.
body_en: dbt treats transformation SQL as code: versioned, testable, documented. Models are SQL files compiled to tables/views. Refs automatically define dependencies. Tests validate data (unique, not_null, custom). Snapshots capture historical changes. Materializations are: table (physical), view (logical), incremental (insert new only), ephemeral (temporary). dbt compiles to DAG executed in destination DB.
example_code:
-- models/staging/stg_users.sql
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

SELECT 
  id,
  LOWER(email) as email,
  created_at::DATE as signup_date
FROM {{ ref('raw_users') }}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

-- tests/stg_users/test_email_unique.sql
SELECT email, COUNT(*)
FROM {{ ref('stg_users') }}
GROUP BY email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
example_output: dbt run compila 50 models, corre 100 tests, genera docs interactivos mostrando linaje datos de raw a reporting.
